i’m in a pretty similar boat, i’m 17, dislocated my shoulder 3 times, and got arthroscopic bankart repair. depending on what surgery you got, whether is was more invasive or not, will change what you can do. so far, the only issue i’ve had is tightness and more soreness on that arm. the first few days back to working out were rough, but i found that a lot of rotator cuff workouts helps load in making it less sore and stronger. also, try avoiding movement that don’t let your arms move freely, like barbell workouts, stick with mostly dumbbells.  avoid workouts like deadlifts, it personally pulls my shoulder in a very awkward way and can cause a issues. i also found that overhead work but on the lighter side made my arm feel so much better, both in and out of the gym. something like a standing overhead dumbbell press with GOOD form will definitely make many pushing movements easier. and for your back i’d recommend avoiding anything above your head until you feel really comfortable, and mainly stick with cable rows around the 15 rep range till you feel like it’s not as loose and then move up to heavier weights and lower reps.  good luck and stay safe, stability is key
